angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 660,915 km at 77.18 pc = 0.11 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 12.9566 +/- 0.0153 mas (same row, RUWE 0.96): 77.18 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 0.95 +/- 0.007 solar radii from Luque et al. 2025, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2141 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract): 660,915 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 0.896 +/- 0.059 solar masses from Luque et al. 2025, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2141 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5635 +/- 61 K from Luque et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2141 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Luque et al. 2025, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2141 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2141.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.435, rounded to two decimals
objectTypeSource: SIMBAD, BD+18 3330: main object type PM*, High Proper Motion Star
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2141 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.14 dex, from Luque et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2141 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units -0.05, from Martioli et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..84M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2141 (pscomppars): age 9 Gyr, from Luque et al. 2025 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2025A&A...704A.174L/abstract)
rotationPeriodSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2141 (pscomppars): rotation period 21 d, from Martioli et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..84M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2141 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 2.7 km/s, from Martioli et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...680A..84M/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
